articles.title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
articles.description:
The trooper placed tracking devices on both his vehicle and his girlfriend’s vehicle but told police that someone else had done it.

The post Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Former NH state trooper decertified for misleading police about GPS tracking.
Trooper placed devices on his and his girlfriend's vehicles without consent.
Incident raises concerns about police accountability and privacy for Boston residents.

articles.title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
articles.description:
Officers responded to Grace Chapel for a report of a man with a gun, but they later learned that there was no threat to the public.

The post Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Police responded to Grace Chapel in Lexington for a report of a man with a gun.
The man was actually polishing a powder horn, causing confusion among officers.
No threat was found, ensuring safety for local residents and churchgoers.
